tagline: Global payments and premium lifestyle brand powered by technology
hero_kpi_rationale: Billed Business is the primary revenue driver for American Express, as it directly fuels transaction fees and card revenues. It is the best indicator of the growth dynamics within its integrated network.
company_description: American Express Company, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an integrated payments company in the United States, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, the Asia Pacific, Australia, New Zealand, Latin America, Canada, the Caribbean, and internationally. It operates through four segments: U.S. Consumer Services, Commercial Services, International Card Services, and Global Merchant and Network Services. The company offers credit and charge cards and complementary products and services, including travel, dining, and lifestyle and expense management products and services; and banking and other payment and financing products and services, including deposits and non-card lending. It also provides merchant acquisition and processing, servicing and settlement, fraud prevention, and point-of-sale marketing and information products and services, as well as network services. kpis.name: Billed Business
kpis.explanation: Total amount of purchases made by cardholders over a given period.
kpis.description: Billed Business increased by 8% in 2025, driven by higher member spending and expansion of the premium card portfolio.
kpis.signal: Strong 8% growth in 2025, driven by consumer and corporate spending.

kpis.name: Discount Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from fees collected on each transaction made with an American Express card.
kpis.description: Discount revenue grew by 6% in 2025, driven by higher billed business volume, despite lower average fee rates.
kpis.signal: Steady growth linked to overall transaction activity.

kpis.name: Net Card Fees
kpis.explanation: Revenue from annual fees and other card-related fees, particularly on premium cards.
kpis.description: Net card fees increased significantly in 2025, due to growth in the premium card portfolio and higher average fees per card.
kpis.signal: Strong 18% growth, supported by high-end cards.

kpis.name: Average Fee per Card
kpis.explanation: Average amount of fees collected per card in force over a year.
kpis.description: Average fee per card rose by 14% in 2025, reflecting product premiumization and demand for exclusive services.
kpis.signal: Marked increase in unit revenue, indicating enhanced value perception of premium cards.

kpis.name: Cards-in-Force
kpis.explanation: Total number of active cards held by customers.
kpis.description: Cards-in-force increased by 4% in 2025, driven by net card acquisitions in both consumer and business segments.
kpis.signal: Steady card base growth, indicating strong customer loyalty.

kpis.name: Network Volumes
kpis.explanation: Total value of transactions processed on the American Express network, including cards issued by partners.
kpis.description: Network volumes increased by 7% in 2025, driven by higher cross-border spending and strategic partnerships.
kpis.signal: Sustained network traffic growth, despite increased competition.

kpis.name: Provision for Credit Losses
kpis.explanation: Amount set aside to cover potential losses on loans to cardholders.
kpis.description: Provision for credit losses increased slightly in 2025, due to moderate deterioration in macroeconomic outlook.
kpis.signal: Credit risk stability despite persistent inflation.

kpis.name: Total Revenues Net
kpis.explanation: Measures American Express's total revenue after deductions for refunds and cancellations.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: This is American Express's net profit: the money left after all expenses. It shows whether the company is profitable.

kpis.name: Net Interest Yield
kpis.explanation: Measures loan profitability after funding costs. Indicates whether American Express earns effectively on its credit products.

kpis.name: Net Write-off Rate
kpis.explanation: Measures the percentage of loans written off as uncollectible. Indicates customer quality and financial health.

kpis.name: Capital Returns to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Measures the amount American Express returns to shareholders via dividends and share buybacks.

kpis.name: DPS
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $1.77 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Cap Return
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $2.271 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 21.0% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Proprietary Cards-in-Force
kpis.explanation: Number of cards issued directly by American Express, excluding partner-issued cards.
kpis.description: Proprietary cards-in-force increased by 4% in 2025, reflecting sustained demand for premium cards such as the Platinum card.
kpis.signal: Steady growth in direct card portfolio, indicating an effective acquisition strategy.

kpis.short: Average Proprietary Basic Card Member Spending
kpis.name: Average Proprietary Basic Card Member Spending
kpis.explanation: Average annual spending per American Express basic cardholder.
kpis.description: Average card member spending increased by 3% in 2025, driven by travel, dining, and leisure.
kpis.signal: Rising per-unit spending, indicating increased loyalty and engagement.

kpis.name: EPS
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding during the fiscal year. Measures the company's ability to generate earnings per share: used to calculate Payout Ratio (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: Five-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).
